assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage protection lines and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.statement_zh: 容积率、建筑高度、建筑密度、退线、道路红线、权属、市政管线与文保控制线均未取得官方条件，方案不给出这些数值结论。
assumptions.impact: Development-intensity metrics stay `unknown`; all spatial moves are conceptual suggestions for professional deepening.
assumptions.impact_zh: 开发强度类指标保持 unknown；所有空间建议均为概念建议，供专业团队深化。
assumptions.resolve_by_zh: 取得资格预审文件附件或官方控规条件后复算并更新 metrics 与图层。

assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and the three key areas use the maintainer-supplied provisional rough polygons, not an official redline.
assumptions.statement_zh: 提交的总体设计范围与三处重点区域使用维护者提供的临时粗略边界，不是官方红线。
assumptions.impact: site_area_sqm、key_area_total_sqm 及全部由边界派生的面积与比例指标均为临时值；官方 polygon 发布后须整包复算。
assumptions.impact_zh: 全部由边界派生的面积与比例为临时值，须在官方数据发布后整包复算。
assumptions.resolve_by_zh: 官方 polygon 进入 brief/site-package/geometry/ 后重跑几何生成、指标复算、图纸与 HTML。

assumptions.statement: The REN spine corridor width (120 m), the ten K-milestone plazas and the five stitching corridors are design proposals generated by the agent, not surveyed or approved dimensions.
assumptions.statement_zh: 折返脊 120 米公园廊道宽度、10 处 K 里程碑广场和 5 条缝合廊道由智能体生成，是概念建议而非实测或已批准尺寸。
assumptions.impact_zh: green_ratio、public_space_ratio、spine_length_m 均随该设计假设变化，须与实测地形、权属和工程条件校核。
assumptions.resolve_by_zh: 由专业团队结合现状测绘、权属与工程条件调整廊道宽度和节点边界后复算。

assumptions.statement: Building footprints represent illustrative renewal and new-build volumes only; they do not enumerate all existing buildings and are not a retain/renovate/demolish decision.
assumptions.statement_zh: 建筑基底仅表达示范性更新与新建体量关系，不是范围内现状建筑的全集，也不构成拆改留结论。
assumptions.impact_zh: building_footprint_area_sqm 只能用于界面与体量讨论，不能推导建筑密度或总建筑规模。
assumptions.resolve_by_zh: 取得现状建筑普查、权属和结构评估资料后重新分类与复算。

assumptions.statement: The 18 renewal projects are conceptual project handles for professional deepening; responsibility, funding, approval and delivery are not confirmed.
assumptions.statement_zh: 18 个更新项目是供专业团队深化的概念抓手，责任主体、资金、审批与实施均未确定。
assumptions.impact_zh: renewal_project_count 只统计方案自身提出的项目条目，不代表已立项或已批准。
assumptions.resolve_by_zh: 由实施主体结合城市更新统筹机制确认项目清单与时序。

assumptions.statement: External statistics (Haidian AI enterprise counts, filed large-model counts) and the six global cases come from media or third-party pages retrieved on 2026-08-10 and are cited as background only.
assumptions.statement_zh: 海淀 AI 企业数量、备案大模型数量与六个国际案例的数据来自 2026-08-10 检索的媒体或第三方页面，仅作背景引用。
assumptions.impact_zh: 这些数字不进入指标复算，也不作为空间控制或产业承诺依据；正文标注为量级背景并说明需复核。
assumptions.resolve_by_zh: 以官方统计公报、政府发布原文或案例官方年报交叉核验后再升级引用等级。

assumptions.statement: The annual event system, developer-community mechanism and scenario-opening operation are proposed operating concepts; they are not confirmed government arrangements, budgets or commitments.
assumptions.statement_zh: 年度活动体系、开发者社区机制与场景开放运营均为运营设想，不是已确定的政府安排、预算或承诺。
assumptions.impact_zh: annual_event_count 仅统计方案提出的活动条目。
assumptions.resolve_by_zh: 由运营主体与主管部门确认后转化为正式计划。

assumptions.statement: Community verification reports that the provisional polygons may be mis-georeferenced: the overall design polygon does not intersect the mapped heritage park (about 412.5 m away, Issue #846) and the Dazhongsi key area centroid sits about 2.26 km from Dazhongsi station (Issue #1029).
assumptions.statement_zh: 社区复核指出临时多边形可能存在定位偏差：总体设计范围与实测遗址公园不相交、最近约 412.5 m（Issue #846）；大钟寺重点区质心距大钟寺站约 2.26 km（Issue #1029）。
assumptions.impact_zh: 本方案的片区定位以公告的片区名称与任务描述为准，不以临时多边形的经纬度为真实地理位置；折返脊走向、三区与 K0–K9 节点的实际落位在官方 polygon 发布后须重新推导，面积与比例随之复算。
assumptions.resolve_by_zh: 以官方 SITE_BOUNDARY 与三处 KEY_AREA polygon 替换后重跑几何生成与全部指标；如维护者确认临时几何需修订，本方案将同步更新。

assumptions.statement: The peer proposal REN AXIS (submissions/Abreto/ren-axis-jingzhang-ai-belt, Issue #215) also uses the 人-shaped switchback as its starting point; this proposal was generated independently and was renamed to The Switchback Belt after that work became known.
assumptions.statement_zh: 同场方案「人字轴 REN AXIS」（submissions/Abreto/ren-axis-jingzhang-ai-belt，Issue #215）同样以人字形折返线为出发点；本方案独立生成，知悉后主动更名为「京张折返带 The Switchback Belt」以避免品牌混淆。
assumptions.impact_zh: 折返原型属于公共文化遗产，不构成排他性主张；本方案在正文、展示页与图纸中明确致谢并说明差异。
assumptions.resolve_by_zh: 如对方或维护者认为仍存在混淆，可进一步调整命名或表述。

assumptions.statement: Every AI scenario in this proposal is specified with data minimisation, public-source-first data, explainability and mandatory human review; no scenario relies on personal profiling, covert tracking or non-public data.
assumptions.statement_zh: 方案中每个 AI 场景都设定数据最小化、公开来源优先、可解释与人工复核边界，不依赖个人画像、隐蔽追踪或非公开数据。
assumptions.impact_zh: 场景卡中的数据项若无法以聚合、脱敏或公开方式获得，应在深化阶段删除或替换。
assumptions.resolve_by_zh: 由数据合规与伦理审查团队在试点前逐场景复核。
